scheme_name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - College/Higher/Technical Educational Fees Refund for Transgender Students
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the transgender community
Applicant must be pursuing a higher or technical course
Applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school, college, or technical education institute in Rajasthan
benefits_summary: Full refund of prescribed educational fees for transgender students, transferred directly to their bank account.
